body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> A very new model of Samsung Electronics which can compete with iPod Touch of Apple has appeared. It's 'Galaxy Player'
As here, the real images of 'Galaxy Player' are revealed at AVING News for the first time.

The real Galaxy Player is not that different from the smartphone Galaxy S. But it has big difference from 'Galaxy Player' which had revealed at IFA 2010, in Germany. It is differentiated from 'YEPP', the MP3 Player Brand of Samsung and almost same as Galaxy S in big popularity now.

Samsung is going to unveil Galaxy Player officially at CES 2011 held at Las Vegas, Nevada from Jan. 6-9, 2011. Let's see whether the Galaxy Player attracts big concentration or not among many tablet PCs and smartphones.
